summary: 21Shares Polkadot ETF filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a staking services agreement with Figment Inc. The agreement governs Figment's staking of DOT tokens to generate rewards for the trust, with the trust retaining discretion to stake/unstake subject to network bonding/unbonding periods. No price, premium, or deal terms are disclosed; the agreement is terminable at will by either party. This is a routine operational service contract, not a special situation. The filing reflects ordinary business activity for a crypto ETF, not an M&A, restructuring, or corporate event. No further action or risk-arb angle exists.
